notes.title: Steam Achievements
notes.content:
[h1]Steam Achievements[/h1]
You can unlock [b]19 Steam Achievements[/b] in the game!

View the list of achievements below -

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35750437/c0208af21618998bb29316d4c37163401fb8062a.jpg[/img]

Achievements are gameplay and story related and unlockable by playing the game, without forcing you to do things just for the sake of gaining the achievement.

Complete all achievements and score a sweet blue ribbon next to the achievement progress bar for 100% game progress.

notes.title: Kickstarter Announcement
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35750437/137455487cd4dc75ff6043e5378bfded3f987a6c.gif[/img]

[h2]Kickstarter Announcement[/h2]

Attention all gamers! We are excited to announce that we will be launching a Kickstarter campaign for the 'House in the Hollow'. 

By supporting our campaign, backers will have the opportunity to be more involved in the development process and receive exclusive rewards.

Stay tuned for more information on the campaign launch date.

So, follow us on Kickstarter and you'll be the first to know when the campaign goes live.

We can't wait for you to be a part of this journey with us!

notes.title: Mysterious Elevator
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35750437/3c0ce5805f80706c8dedcf60fe0aa18cf14dfa17.jpg[/img]

The mysterious elevator lays hidden somewhere within the Barrett estate manor house.

Search the manor to discover its location and uncover the secret of the lift’s ultimate destination.


[h2]Announcing Ray Tracing Support[/h2]

The House in The Hollow will feature full support for global illumination, ray traced reflections, ray traced shadows, ray traced ambient occlusion including ray traced translucency.

The game can be enjoyed on graphics cards without raytracing support, but to enhance the games visuals a ray tracing capable graphics card will enable the most realistic and beautiful game world and environment possible for the player to explore.
